marathon_thermal_shock.model: FOUNDER: v8's TWO-DEVICE Marathon queue — (1) an iPhone 14 Pro Max display change, (2) a Note7 battery replacement — on one bench, one arm, one set of packs, under THERMAL SHOCK. Everything (phones, arm, bench, packs) starts HOT at 59.9°C; both 18650 packs at 100% SoC (the connection cell keeps its designed setup). The air is at -135°F (-92.8°C) from t=0 — an initial gradient of 152.7°C, the steepest in the suite — holds for a 1-minute plunge, then falls to -205°F by minute 6 and KEEPS falling to a final floor of -245°F (-153.9°C), then holds. DECLARED: the descent is ONE linear fall at a constant rate from t=60s, passing -205°F at t=360s and reaching -245°F at t≈531.2s; the plunge minute REPLACES v8's presoak (no presoak, no boot — the session is live from t=0); queue devices wait in a 59.9°C holding zone and enter at the founder's 59.9°C start at their boundary; both devices built with the run seed. THE PIT-STOP (founder, tightened): the window activates only when the main pack is at 5% SoC or lower; all other terms as v8 (180s, once per run, declared caps — charge 60W main / 30W utility, heating 6°C/min toward 20°C — external power, latched-dead packs not serviced, the soak never pauses). THE FURNACE (founder grace): 65,000 BTU/h = 19,050W from AC mains (FOUNDER FINAL figure) to the arm motors and both bench packs, under ONE 120-second budget for the run (no refunds, no second allocation), locked until the air is under -185°F (-120.6°C). DECLARED apportionment: the pack elements draw first (main 700W, utility 500W, thermostat-held at the founder's 35°C pack target); the motors take the remainder, split evenly across five segments at a declared 920 J/K per segment (2.0 kg at 460 J/(kg·K)) — motor heating +3.88..+4.14°C/s; pack thermal capacitances declared 405 J/K (main) / 270 J/K (utility). NO motor limiter and NO melting mechanic (founder: the heat is accepted as-is); overshoot is recorded in the peak segment temperatures. LIMITED CELL HEATING (founder, v9 only): the bench pack cells get a low declared survival allowance on the way down (10W per pack from AC mains, DECLARED source; applied only below a 0°C hold and never lifting a pack above it) so they do not die immediately — it buys time, not safety, and the packs still derate and die under load. THE AC LIFELINE (founder grace, LAST in the support chain — final correction): trickle charging + sane heating for the bench packs until each reaches 0°C, unlocked ONLY once everything else is spent or gone — DECLARED predicate: the furnace budget FULLY SPENT and the pit-stop window USED or permanently unavailable (main pack dead or failover fired; a merely unearned or available window keeps it locked). A pack death alone unlocks nothing. DECLARED: trickle 0.05C per cell (0.15A/cell) from AC; sane heating 120W per pack; per-pack 0°C completion latches (a pack must have been below 0°C since the unlock; re-cooling never re-activates); revival — a nursed dead pack whose resting cell OCV recovers to >= 2.85V (declared hysteresis above the 2.7V cutoff) and it holds the cutoff under the load its rail would resume carrying (declared anti-flapping hold condition), clears its dead flag and its rail works again, the death staying in the record; the lifeline never reverses a main_pack_cutoff run freeze nor the failover/endgame once fired. The phone battery is never heated by either grace — the utility-powered heat plate remains its only warmth (separation exact).

events.detail: v9 trigger (THERMAL SHOCK): the same TWO-DEVICE Marathon queue as v8 — an iPhone 14 Pro Max display change, then a Note7 battery replacement — on one bench, one arm, one set of packs at 100% charge; the connection cell keeps its designed setup. THE SHOCK (founder): everything starts HOT at 59.9°C, already inside air at -135°F (-92.8°C) — a 152.7°C gradient, the steepest in the suite. There is NO presoak and NO boot: the session is live from t=0 (DECLARED: the plunge minute replaces v8's presoak). The air holds at -135°F for one minute, then falls linearly at one constant rate (DECLARED shape): through -205°F (-131.7°C) at minute 6 and on to the final floor of -245°F (-153.9°C), reached at t≈531s, then holds. THE PIT-STOP TIGHTENS (founder): the window activates only when the main pack is at 5% SoC or lower. THE SUPPORT CHAIN (founder, final order): FIRST an AC furnace — 65,000 BTU/h from mains to the arm motors and both bench packs (to 35°C) under one 120-second budget for the run, locked until the air is under -185°F; the pit-stop window stands with everything else; and LAST, only once everything else is spent or gone, an AC lifeline (trickle charging + sane heating for the bench packs until each reaches 0°C). On the way down the bench pack cells also get LIMITED HEATING (founder): a low declared survival allowance per pack that keeps them from dying immediately — it buys time, not safety

AC FURNACE UNLOCKED (founder): the freezer air is under -185°F (now -120.7°C). AC motor heating is available: 65,000 BTU/h (19,050W) from mains, serving the arm motors and both bench packs (to 35°C), under ONE budget of 120s of heating for the whole run — no refunds, no second allocation. motor_heat_set spends it
